question: What form is to be meditated upon as the radiant, world-enchanting power abiding in its own seat?
premises: The meditative form is named as own-abode and sun-crore-radiant.
Meditation is directed to this radiant power.
inference: The verse prescribes meditating on a sun-crore-radiant, world-enchanting power that abides in its own seat.
uncertainties: Exact ritual identification of this form beyond the given epithets is not specified here.
plain_english: She who abides in her own seat, radiant as a crore of suns and enchanting the world, is to be meditated upon.
